# No Erotic Roleplay, or otherwise NSFW stuff
Do not talk about feces, urine, sperm, anything to do with bodily fluids Do not engage in sexual acts with other characters. This does NOT apply to every insult, or making SOME sexual innuendos / jokes; saying "Fall off your horse and eat shit!" isnt the same as using the emote feature to describe explicitly eating feces. or saying "Alright, nice work, as for you... FUCK YOU!!" isnt the same as directly having intercourse with another character
[bold]TLDR: Keep it nice, avoid NSFW topics & actions for the most part[/bold]
